name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Richter is a seasoned sporting director with a lifelong passion for motorsport, tracing back to his childhood spent karting in Kerpen. He transitioned to engineering after university, contributing to the design and development of touring cars for various German manufacturers. A meticulous and data-driven approach quickly earned him recognition, leading to his appointment as team manager for a smaller Formula 3 outfit.

He joined PEX Motorsport five years ago, initially as a technical consultant, where he streamlined their vehicle dynamics program. His ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, coupled with his natural leadership qualities, secured his promotion to Sporting Director. Klaus-Dieter believes in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and open communication, ensuring that every member of the team contributes to the collective success. He is known for his unflappable demeanor under pressure and his strategic brilliance in race management.

Klaus-Dieter's distinctive approach lies in his insistence on empirical evidence over intuition. He champions simulation and data analysis to inform decisions, pushing PEX Motorsport to embrace cutting-edge technology and methodologies. He sees the Sporting Director role as a blend of engineering precision and people management – finding the optimal balance between technical prowess and team dynamics.

physical.description: A man of average height with a sturdy build, he always looks impeccably groomed.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when under stress.
Insists on drinking herbal tea during races, believing it enhances his focus.
